note_on_origin: Client persona artefact (fictional Voltra Charging Network). Mirrors the FlashEats client_metric_definitions.json pattern. Not derived from any real operator statement.
leadership_claim: Our DC fast-charging network runs at 99% uptime.
leadership_request: Customer complaints say chargers don't work. Our dashboard says they do. Tell us which is true and where to send crews.

stakeholders.VP Operations / NOC: A port is up when it is connected and not reporting Faulted. Scheduled maintenance and utility power interruptions are excluded because they are outside our control. This is the 99% on our dashboard.
stakeholders.Grants & Compliance: We report to funders under federal NEVI-style rules: a port is up only if it is online AND successfully dispenses electricity at the required power. Annual uptime must exceed 97%. Failures caused by the vehicle, utility outages, scheduled maintenance, vandalism and natural disasters are excluded.
stakeholders.Customer Experience: A charger is working only if the driver's first try works. Drivers who have to retry or leave without charge are our complaints.
stakeholders.Field-service vendor: Reliability means work orders closed within SLA. If no alarm fires, there is nothing to dispatch.

reporting_facts.session_error_field: Exported in every session file; the CPMS vendor says it is populated 'when the charger reports an error'.

note: No canonical owner of the reliability KPI is formally documented.
